summary: Iteration 53: Verified BankEzee Connect Meta module isolation. Backend 23/23 pytest passed: access-off 403 for admin, GP scoping (150 leads, all assigned_partner_id==meta_uid), processor scoping, status change + activity persistence, note add + activity, GP forbidden from /assign, /partners, /users, /admin/user-management, files 149 with binary_pending, download 409, duplicate meta_user mapping rejected 400 'already mapped', staff-only user mgmt, and Connect regression (auth/me, files/dashboard/stats, leads list) all 200. Frontend verified: Admin (no meta_access) sees NO 'Meta CRM' nav and /admin/meta shows meta-no-access. GP nav under /agent/meta loads 3 tabs (Dashboard/Leads/Files), 150 assigned leads paginated, User Mgmt tab absent, lead detail opens with status buttons + note input + NO assign select. Processor /manager/meta shows exactly 1 scoped lead, no User Mgmt tab. No page errors.

ui_bugs.issue: Connect Admin (user.role=='admin' but meta_access=false) is blocked by the early 'if (!user?.meta_access) return <no-access>' guard on line 331, so the required 'User Mgmt' tab at /admin/meta is never rendered. Per spec, admin@bankezee.com must see the User Mgmt tab even without meta_access. Backend /api/meta/admin/user-management already gates via require_admin (works fine) - only the UI is blocking. Fix: bypass the meta_access guard when user.role==='admin' and render a minimal admin shell containing only the User Mgmt tab (dashboard/leads/files require meta_access, so they can be hidden for admin-without-access).

verified_items.access_off_admin_no_nav: PASS - no 'Meta CRM' nav text on admin, /api/meta/me and /api/meta/leads both 403
verified_items.gp_scoping: PASS - all lead rows have assigned_partner_id == GP's meta_user_id; UI shows 150 leads
verified_items.processor_scoping: PASS - UI 1 lead; API returns leads with assigned_processor_id == teja's meta_user_id
verified_items.status_write: PASS - PATCH /leads/{id}/status persisted status=CALL_BACK and appended status_change activity
verified_items.note_write: PASS - POST /leads/{id}/notes appended note + activity type=note
verified_items.assign_forbidden_for_gp: PASS - PATCH /assign 403; UI has no meta-assign-select for GP
verified_items.duplicate_meta_mapping_rejected: PASS - PATCH /admin/users/{id} with an already-linked meta_user_id -> 400 'already mapped'

action_items: HIGH: /app/frontend/src/pages/meta/MetaApp.js line 331 - allow Connect admin (user.role==='admin') to bypass the meta_access guard and show at least the 'User Mgmt' tab, since spec explicitly requires admin@bankezee.com to see User Mgmt at /admin/meta despite having no meta_access.
critical_code_review_comments: meta.py _lead_scope falls back to assigned_partner_id filter for any non-staff/non-processor role - safe default but rely on meta_role_normalized being one of the four META_ROLES; consider explicit reject for unknown meta_role instead of implicit GP scoping.

meta.py /files/{id}/download always raises 409 (unconditional after the doc lookup) which is currently by design (binary_pending backfill) - once migration completes, the second unconditional raise must be removed or it will return 409 for real files too.

MetaApp.js relies on user.meta_access from auth store; ensure login response and /auth/me both include meta_access/meta_role/meta_email/meta_user_id consistently so a page refresh doesn't drop meta context.

success_rate.frontend: ~90% - all role/scoping/write flows pass; Connect Admin User Mgmt UI blocked

seed_data_creation: Test writes on isolated meta_leads only: 1 lead of GP nithin now has status=CALL_BACK and a 'TEST_iteration53 automated note'. Isolated collection, does not affect Connect CRM.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Regression file /app/backend/tests/test_meta_module.py has 23 tests across TestAccessOff, TestGrowthPartner, TestProcessor, TestAdminUserMgmt, TestConnectRegression. All pass as of iteration 53. Frontend Meta nav testids: meta-tab-{dashboard|leads|files|users}, meta-lead-row, meta-status-<STATUS>, meta-assign-select (staff-only), meta-note-input/meta-note-add, meta-user-edit-<id>, meta-access-toggle, meta-role-select, meta-email-input, meta-user-map-select, meta-user-save, meta-no-access banner. Known open UI bug: admin cannot reach User Mgmt tab because of meta_access guard in MetaApp.js line 331.
rca of the issue: MetaApp.js short-circuits on `if (!user?.meta_access) return <no-access>` BEFORE computing tabs. Since Connect admin currently has meta_access=false (per problem statement), the admin-only User Mgmt tab is never mounted, contradicting the requirement. Repro: login admin@bankezee.com -> navigate /admin/meta -> meta-no-access banner instead of meta-tab-users. Mitigation: change guard to `if (!user?.meta_access && user?.role !== 'admin')` and render a shell with only the users tab for admin-without-meta_access, OR grant admin meta_access=true with meta_role='admin' via seed.
